english.title: Disqualified solicitor failing to disclose he / she was struck off / suspended
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) while being disqualified from practising as a solicitor by reason of the fact that

(A)_[your name had been struck off the roll of solicitors,]_
(B)_[you were suspended from practising as a solicitor,]_
(C)_[your practising certificate was suspended while you were an undischarged bankrupt,]_

you

(D)_[sought]_
(E)_[accepted]_

employment by a solicitor, namely, **(..SPECIFY NAME OF SOLICITOR..), in connection with that solicitor's practice without previously informing that person that you were so disqualified
english.legislation: Contrary to section 42(1) of the Solicitors Act 1974.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Attorney General's consent required
(ii) Proceedings under this section may be commenced at any time before the expiration of six months after the first discovery of the offence by the prosecutor.
(iii) No person shall be qualified to act as a solicitor unless his name is on the roll - i.e. the list of solicitors kept in accordance with section 6(1) of the Act - and he has in force a practising certificate (section 1) and a person who is not qualified is referred to in this part as an "unqualified person"

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level one on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
